attachments.origin_landmark: soleal line + posterior tibia; also fibular head/proximal fibula (fibula_r)
attachments.insertion_landmark: calcaneus (via Achilles tendon, joined by gastrocnemius)

actions: plantarflexes ankle (primary postural/gait plantarflexor -- crosses only the ankle, unlike gastrocnemius, so remains effective regardless of knee position)

functional_compartments.name: Single continuous multipennate mass (some studies describe faint superficial/deep compartment banding, not independently innervated)

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: along the extensive central aponeurosis (soleus is a classically 'unipennate-to-multipennate' short-fiber, high-PCSA design specialized for sustained postural force) -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Largest PCSA of any lower-leg muscle -- short fascicles + very high pennation give enormous force at low shortening velocity, matched to its role as the primary antigravity/postural plantarflexor (slow-twitch dominant).
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_to: proximal border of the medial tibial condyle
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Three-fifths of length, present both medially and laterally. This line runs DISTAL to PROXIMAL, so 60% sits in the proximal half of the leg.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity, Part IV -- Distal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(10):508 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17100508 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites (Lee, Yi and others)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
